name: Variable Number of Conditioning Views Feature Aggregation
aliases: Permutation Invariant Feature Aggregation with Viewpoint Info
definition: Aggregates features for an unknown number of conditioning views using a permutation invariant function to handle varying input dimensions at inference time.
summary: Variable Number of Conditioning Views Feature Aggregation combines pixel-aligned features from any number of views into a single vector using permutation-invariant methods like max pooling to handle depth ambiguity artifacts.
